task: Audit emitter expression parser counters during retained-tree migration.
observation: Two emitter parse paths were outside the existing reparsing counter: borrowed-view index inspection called parse_view directly, and named-argument projection called parse_named_argument_view directly. Routing the first through expression_view_from_est and counting the second increases accounting visibility without changing generated Rust.
impact: Prior paired consumer counts undercounted these parse sites, so historical sample deltas are not strictly comparable without matching instrumentation on the phase27-5-3-c1 baseline.
evidence: examples/collections_and_methods.moss: candidate 1,244 text lookups / 532 expression-view reparses; generated Rust identical to c96 parent

resolution.summary: Instrument the same sites in the pinned parent build before reporting a strict paired delta.

task: Lower a pipeline represented by retained EST nodes without parsing its source text.
observation: Bootstrap and source inspection found no optimizer parser entry point. In the emitter, functional_pipeline() intentionally recognizes only built-in operations, while the checker records user-named pipeline stages as ordinary call edges. Reading the retained Pipeline/Call nodes plus those checked edges allowed direct nested-call lowering without a functional plan.
impact: For mini_application.moss, native functional-pipeline reparses fell from 2 to 0 and total expression reparses fell from 6,122 to 2,018 against the counter-matched parent, with byte-identical Rust and runtime output.

resolution.summary: The checked callable-pipeline node path handles the pure local fixture shape. Other pipeline node shapes still need coverage and lowering.
